name: CIMB Visa Infinite Card

percent:baseline.note: Unlimited | 1% cashback on all local spend. No minimum spend required. No cashback cap.

percent:overseas_online_shopping.note: Unlimited | With $2,000 min. spend posted in the same statement month. No cap.

percent:overseas.note: Unlimited | For a limited time, earn 3% on overseas foreign currency spend (valid till 31 Jan 2025). 2% cashback on overseas and travel related spend. Charge a minimum of S$2,000 in month. No cashback cap.

percent:travel.note: Unlimited | 2% cashback on overseas and travel related spend with $2,000 min. spend posted in the same statement month. No cap.

highlights: Unlimited  | For a limited time, earn 3% on overseas foreign currency spend (valid till 31 Jan 2025). Enjoy unlimited 1% cashback on all local spending, including health, department stores, online bill payments, transport, dining, supermarkets, petrol, retail, and local online shopping, with no minimum spend or cashback cap. For overseas and travel-related spending, earn 2% cashback with a minimum spend of S$2,000 in the same statement month, also with no cashback cap.
pros: Unlimited 2% cashback on travel, overseas spend and online spend in foreign currencies.
pros: Unlimited 1% on all other retail spends.
pros: Principal cardmembers enjoy 3 complimentary global lounge access at more than 1,000 airports annually.
pros: Charge your full travel fares to your CIMB Visa Infinite and automatically get travel insurance coverage of up to S$1 million for you and your family.
pros: No annual fees for life + Up to 4 supplementary cards with no annual fees.
cons: Min. spending of S$2,000 in the statement month to qualify for the 2% cashback.
cons: Only Singapore citizens and Permanent Residents may apply.
cons: Minimum annual income requirement: S$120,000.

extra.tag: Best for luxury travel & premium lifestyle
extra.description: The CIMB Visa Infinite Card is a premium travel card that allows you to earn unlimited 2% cashback on travel and overseas transactions, provided a minimum spend of S$2,000 is made within a statement month. Travel perks include 3 complimentary lounge visits per year and complimentary travel insurance with coverage up to S$1 million. Its annual fee is also waived for life!
